dog.description_text:
Hi, I'm Mimi — a 2-year-old brown and white mixed breed girl with an adventurous spirit and endless energy! 🐾 At 35 pounds, I'm the perfect medium-sized companion for someone who loves to stay active and explore. I'm spayed and ready to roll, plus I'm friendly, loyal, and smart — which means I'll be right by your side for whatever comes next. Whether it's a hike, a road trip, or just a day of play, I'm game for it all! 💪 My adoption fee is $325, so come meet me and let's start our next adventure together! 🐕
This cutie resides at our Westhampton location If you are interested in meeting them, click "Apply for Adoption" to submit an online application. If you're viewing this animal on Petfinder, please visit the animal's page on Bideawee.org and click on the "Apply for Adoption" button to submit an adoption application.Prior to adoption, all of our animals are spayed/neutered, microchipped and given their age-appropriate vaccines
